title: Governed dispatch bridge for authenticated Hostinger build evidence

phases.objective: Provide one owner-authorized, checksum-bound, one-time issue-comment bridge that dispatches the existing trusted-main authenticated GET-only Hostinger build-history workflow and validates its structured artifact without reading the Hostinger secret or mutating Hostinger, Production, or repository contents.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository owner and trusted default-branch GitHub Actions bridge
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact owner-authored RUN_HOSTINGER_NODEJS_BUILD_EVIDENCE_F5C1AE88_09578A2C comment on open Incident #4953 after immutable authorization comment #5161758022
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bridge validates the open incident, authorization author and text, target workflow blob, active workflow state, exact protected Production SHA, and one-time binding; dispatches the unchanged workflow on main with typed inputs; resolves the exact new run; validates its redacted structured artifact; and records a bounded completed or fail-closed marker while leaving the incident open.
steps: Receive the exact issue_comment trigger only on open top-level Incident #4953 from an OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR whose numeric user ID matches the repository owner authorization.

Read authorization comment #5161758022 and require its exact token, workflow blob, Hostinger account, domain, Production SHA, merge timestamp, GET-only boundary, and provider-mutation false statement.
Verify the registered target workflow is active on trusted main and its blob remains 09578a2c9adcd0d1254b345248c33d2ba214d41f.
Verify protected Production remains exactly f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896 and reject any changed deployment target.
Reject duplicate dispatch when a dispatched or completed marker already exists for the same authorization binding.
Record a one-time claiming marker and dispatch hostinger-nodejs-build-evidence.yml on main with account username, expected Production SHA, and Production merge timestamp.
Resolve only a newer workflow_dispatch run whose head SHA matches the trusted main SHA captured before dispatch.

Wait for completion, download only the exact run-bound hostinger-nodejs-build-evidence artifact, and validate its identity, GET method, token-returned false field, secret-free declaration, and false mutation side effects.
Record the target conclusion, evidence classification, build UUID and state, first failure, credential-access indicator, and artifact ID in a bounded issue marker while leaving #4953 open.
assertions: The bridge has issue_comment and pull_request entrypoints but no pull_request_target trigger.
The bridge grants actions:write and issues:write only to the trusted dispatch job and never grants contents:write or write-all.
The bridge contains no HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN reference, secret expression, Hostinger provider URL, Node.js builds endpoint, or direct provider request.
Only the unchanged target workflow accesses HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN and performs authenticated GET requests.
The trigger comment, authorization comment ID, authorization user ID, target workflow blob, account, domain, Production SHA, and merge timestamp are exact immutable bindings.
The bridge verifies the current Production ref before dispatch and the current main head when resolving the target run.
One-time claiming, dispatched, completed, and failed markers are bound to the exact Production SHA, target workflow blob, and authorization comment.

Structured evidence validation requires the expected branch Production, expected SHA, fixed auth.mad4b.com domain, GET method, token_returned=false, secrets_included=false, and every mutation side effect false.
The incident remains open regardless of target workflow conclusion because build evidence alone does not prove active runtime parity.
No build creation, deployment, restart, provider mutation, repository contents mutation, SQL execution, migration Apply, database mutation, external send, protected-ref update, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe one authorized issue comment dispatch the trusted target workflow, produce an authenticated Hostinger artifact, and publish a run-bound classification on Incident #4953.

Exercise wrong author, closed issue, changed authorization, changed target blob, changed Production SHA, inactive target workflow, duplicate marker, unresolved run, missing artifact, malformed evidence, and unavailable repository secret while remaining fail-closed and mutation-free.
The bridge dispatches a read-only evidence workflow and performs no provider or deployment canary.
The bridge does not deploy or mutate Production; exact runtime parity remains a separate completion requirement under Incident #4953.
